summary: Which part of an image stays visible when object-fit crops it.
details: With object-fit: cover, the image fills its frame and the overflow is cut off. object-position chooses the anchor, like background-position does for backgrounds, so you can keep a subject in view as the frame changes shape across screen sizes.

values.note: Default: crop evenly from all sides.
Keep the right edge in view.
Keep the top, crop the bottom (good for portraits).
Keep the point 75% across and 30% down in view.

gotcha: It only has a visible effect when the image is cropped or letterboxed, so pair it with object-fit: cover (or contain) and a frame of a different shape.
